description: Installation of replacement internally illuminated fascia sign and new internally illuminated projection sign.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 4 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity

Condition : 5 - The luminance of the signs shall not exceed 240 cd/m2 at any time, or exceed the levels set out in the Institution of Lighting Professionals report PLG05 THE BRIGHTNESS OF ILLUMINATED ADVERTISEMENTS (2015).
Condition : 6 - The proposed signage must not have any intermittent light source, animation, moving feature or exposed cold cathode tubing.

Condition : 7 - The footway and carriageway on Chiswick High Road must not be blocked during the construction and maintenance of the proposal. Temporary obstruction during the installation must be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrian, or obstruct the flow of traffic.
